title: DXF DICTIONARY per-entry handle-code retention
mode: Local implementation and generated fast validation
scope: Retain group 350/360 independently per parsed DICTIONARY key/handle pair.
Use retained codes in the direct and registered named-dictionary writer paths while preserving legacy fallback for unspecified entries.
Exercise ASCII and Binary inputs/outputs, both flag-280 values, reversed key order, copy/assignment, and typed readback in an existing selector.
Record the ABI-version decision and release-time check without adding a persistent drawing fixture or a new CTest target.

behavior: Parsed 350 and 360 codes are stored with their individual key/handle entries.
Copy construction and assignment preserve the code as part of the entry value.
Direct and registered named DICTIONARY writers replay parsed codes per entry.
Newly constructed and DWG-origin entries use Unspecified and keep the existing hardOwner-derived output policy.
Generated NOD entries remain on their separate group-350 path.
DICTIONARYWDFLT writer remains on its object-specific group-350 output grammar.
generatedCases: flag 280 equal to zero and one
literal output key/code/handle tuples for direct and named-dictionary writers
typed readback of the same targets and generated SCALE objects
implementation.fixturePolicy: Controls are generated in the system temporary directory and removed by test cleanup; no test drawing is committed.

The official GitHub releases page reports no releases at https://github.com/LibreCAD/libdxfrw/releases.
abiDecision.decision: Keep the repository's intended 2.0.0 development boundary; recheck external package registries before publishing. If a distributed ABI-2 artifact exists, apply release-time ABI/SOVERSION policy before publishing. Rebuild consumers against the new public header.
limits: No external package-registry inventory or installed old-binary compatibility test was run.
The version decision is not evidence that old binary consumers are compatible.
